title: Dispatch FLE 9: A Second Life Is Added to the Institute Archive
summary: The funeral dispute ends with both accounts intact.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Lydia Voss donated copies of her mother’s letters to the Institute. Dr. Voss supplied the expedition log that had previously been treated as the sole account. The archive holds them side by side, with neither marked false.

At the grave, Lydia left the schoolbook open to a page of children’s drawings. The living Dr. Voss did not attend. She sent a note saying the book belonged there and asking Lydia to tell her if she ever wanted to speak again.
